Returns follow a normal distribution with mean 12%12\%12% and volatility 20%20\%20%.

Find the probability that a return exceeds 32%32\%32%.

  • The Return Distribution: Mean and Volatility
Show solution

  1. Standardize: z=(32−12)/20=1z = (32 - 12) / 20 = 1z=(32−12)/20=1.

  2. The exceedance probability is 1−Φ(1)≈1−0.841=0.1591 - \Phi(1) \approx 1 - 0.841 = 0.1591−Φ(1)≈1−0.841=0.159.

Answer

About 0.1590.1590.159, that is about 15.9%15.9\%15.9%
